United States Department of the Interior

Northeast Region

Boston, Massachusetts 02109
July 27, 1977
Mr. Marvin Siflinger
Acting Area Office Director
Department of Housing and
Urban Development
15 New Chardon Street
Boston, Massachusetts 02114
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
This is in response to your letter of June 21 requesting our Departmental review of your draft environmental statement for the Kendall Square Remewal Project in Cambridge, Massachusetts. We find two areas of concern as follows.
Outdoor Recreation
On page II-3-72, it is vaguely stated that "... some additional open space may be needed in those plans where a residential population is proposed." This should be strengthened to indicate quantitatively how much open space will be provided for various levels of residential development. Further, these estimates should be based on the assumption that private open space will not be provided through the design of individual buildings.
Archeological Considerations
On page II-4-7 there is a negative statement on the potential for the project's impact on archeological values with reference to a letter from the State Archeologist in Appendix D. That letter (dated June 29, 1976 from Maurice Robbins) states there are two known archeological sites in the study area and suggests that the impacts on these should be further evaluated. We agree with the State Archeologist and recommend that the final environmental include an adequately substantiated discussion of the accomplishment of such evaluations.
